_comment_: Template for credentials.json — the unified connections registry.
Copy this file to credentials.json, fill in real values, and run.
credentials.json is gitignored; this example IS tracked.
1. SAMMY_CONNECTIONS_FILE env var (absolute or relative path)
2. <repoRoot>/credentials.json (the file you create from this template)
Per-node references resolve `credential: "openai-prod"` against the keys here.

openai.description: Default OpenAI API key — the canonical name `openai` is the fallback when env var OPENAI_API_KEY isn't set.

anthropic.description: Default Anthropic API key — fallback for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

atlassian-prod.description: Per-orchestration credential — restrict via owners/orchestrations if multi-tenant.

github-cli.description: Classic PAT with repo scope. github.com/settings/tokens.

mcp-atlassian.description: Supplies the env block for the `atlassian` entry in mcp/servers.json. Note the ${connections:...} refs — secrets stay in atlassian-prod, not duplicated here.

partner-team-a2a.description: Remote A2A endpoint. Orchestrations reference with `a2a.agentCard: "${connections:partner-team-a2a.url}"`.

aws-stage.description: AWS SSO — token cache lives under `cache:` and is refreshed on demand. SSO refresh flow is planned (phase 2 of connections work); for now this lands as schema-only.
